newsitem.title: USA: Typhoon Rosie to make landfall in Honshu Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Rosie to make landfall in Honshu Saturday.

text.p: LEXINGTON, Mass, July 25 - Typhoon Rosie, weakening south of Japan, should have top winds of 75 mph when it makes landfall in southwestern Honshu, during Saturday, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
The typhoon, with 105 mph winds, is near 27.5N/134.1E, moving north northeast at 15 mph.
Rosie would probably produce coastal flooding, heavy rainfall leading to flooding and mudslides and wind damage, with the worst expected to occur in southwestern and central Honshu during Saturday.
